nameJa: ミッドナイト・ブロードキャスト
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 黒と朱色のステージに、動画と半透明チャットを重ねた放送グラフィック。大きい見出しと浅い奥行きで力強く見せる。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one finished Chrome Web Store promotional tile, not a mockup or contact sheet. Create a sophisticated ABSTRACT brand graphic for the YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen extension. Edge-to-edge landscape 11:7 composition (target 1760 x 1120). Concept 10: midnight broadcast editorial. Inky charcoal background with subtle warm photographic grain, sculptural matte vermilion red video plane seen almost head-on, a precise white fullscreen corner frame around it. One beautiful smoke-glass chat panel is entirely INSIDE the video's right edge, with three restrained geometric avatar dots and message strokes, and a minimal bottom input line. A white triangular play mark sits in the remaining video area. It should explain video plus live chat together in fullscreen without a literal screenshot. Use controlled shallow depth and soft realistic contact shadows, exquisite spacing, Swiss editorial typography, strong composition. The interface graphic occupies the lower-right 60%; large left/top typography feels like a premium music broadcast identity.
Text, verbatim, each once: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Preserve exact capitalization; Fullscreen is ONE word F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n. YouTube is one word Y-o-u-T-u-b-e. Make all three terms comfortably legible even when reduced to 220 x 140, dominant clean bold sans-serif, no tiny subtitles. Set YouTube as the upper brand label and Fullscreen / Live Chat as the big two-line headline with careful optical spacing, no overlap with the icon. Keep every letter within 7% safe margins.
Art direction: editorial brand design with a tactile finish, restrained premium materials and warmth, streaming culture with strong red/white/black identity. Not a bare SVG wireframe, not a glossy generic AI tech ad. No people, no landscapes, no gaming scene, no real streamer, no monitor photograph, no cartoon, no neon beams, no floating decorative blobs, no paragraphs, no additional words, no numbers, no watermark. ONE complete promotional image.
